records.rationale: In `admin-group.js.es6`, the new `addMembers` action calls `this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));` but does not `set("usernames", null/"")` afterward; there’s even an inline comment `// TODO: should clear the input`, confirming the field is never reset after adding.

In `discourse/models/group.js`, `addMembers` returns the `Discourse.ajax(...).then(...)` promise, so failures would be unhandled at this call site, potentially resulting in silent UI failure/no feedback. records.issue_text: routes.rb defines PUT/DELETE members routes without an :id/group_id in the URL path, weakening REST scoping and authorization intent
records.rationale: In config/routes.rb the `delete "members"` and `put "members"` routes are defined *inside* `resources :groups` (and not inside a `collection do` block). In Rails this creates member-scoped routes (i.e., they include the group identifier segment like `/admin/groups/:id/members`), so they are not “without an :id/group_id in the URL path” as claimed.

records.issue_text: groups_controller.rb#members offset param has no lower/upper bound clamping, allowing negative or huge offsets to be passed directly to .offset()
records.rationale: In GroupsController#members, `offset = params[:offset].to_i` is passed directly into `group.users.order(:username_lower).limit(limit).offset(offset)` with no clamping/validation. This allows negative offsets (and arbitrarily large offsets) from the request to reach ActiveRecord/SQL, which can cause errors or unexpected behavior depending on the DB.
